AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Spendly helps users track expenses, payments, lending, and borrowings. Operational Patterns: Use 'trackExpense' when the user asks to track, log, note, or record money spent, lent, or borrowed in Spendly (for example: 'track 1000 lending to Sreenu in Spendly'). Constraints: The input text must contain the expense or loan details spoken by the user.
